verses.text: The LORD said to Moses,
"Send some men to explore the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the people of Israel. Send one leader from each of the ancestral tribes."
So Moses sent them out from the desert of Paran, as the LORD had commanded. All of them were leaders among the people of Israel.
These were their names: From the tribe of Reuben, Shammua son of Zaccur.
From the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat son of Hori.
From the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh.
From the tribe of Issachar, Igal son of Joseph.
From the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea son of Nun.
From the tribe of Benjamin, Palti son of Raphu.
From the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel son of Sodi.
From the tribe of Manasseh, one of Joseph's tribes, Gaddi son of Susi.
From the tribe of Dan, Ammiel son of Gemalli.
From the tribe of Asher, Sethur son of Michael.
From the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi son of Vophsi.
From the tribe of Gad, Geuel son of Machi.
These are the names of the men Moses sent to explore the land. Moses gave Hoshea son of Nun the name Joshua.
When Moses sent them to explore Canaan, he said, "Go up through the Negev, the dry south land, and on into the hill country.
See what the land is like. Find out whether the people who live there are strong or weak, few or many.
Is the land they live in good or bad? Are their towns open camps or protected by walls?
Is the soil rich or poor? Are there trees on it or not? Be brave, and bring back some of the fruit of the land." It was the season for the first ripe grapes.
So they went up and explored the land, from the desert of Zin as far as Rehob, near the road to Hamath.
They went up through the Negev and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai lived, the descendants of Anak. Hebron had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.
When they came to the Valley of Eshcol, they cut off a branch with a single bunch of grapes. Two of them carried it on a pole between them. They also brought back some pomegranates and figs.
That place was called the Valley of Eshcol, which means bunch of grapes, because of the bunch the people of Israel cut there.
After forty days of exploring the land, they came back.
They came to Moses, Aaron, and the whole community of Israel at Kadesh, in the desert of Paran. They reported to them and to the whole community and showed them the fruit of the land.
They told Moses, "We went into the land where you sent us. It really is a land flowing with milk and honey! Here is some of its fruit.
But the people who live there are strong, and their towns have walls and are very large. We even saw the descendants of Anak there.
The Amalekites live in the Negev. The Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites live in the hill country. The Canaanites live near the sea and along the Jordan River."
Then Caleb quieted the people in front of Moses and said, "Let's go up right now and take the land. We can certainly do it!"
But the men who had gone with him said, "We cannot attack those people. They are stronger than we are."

So they spread a bad report among the people of Israel about the land they had explored. They said, "The land we explored destroys the people who live in it. All the people we saw there are very tall.
We even saw the Nephilim there, the descendants of Anak, who come from the Nephilim. Next to them we felt like grasshoppers, and that is how we looked to them."
